newsitem.title: ESTONIA: KAUBAMAJA F SAYS SALES AS EXPECTED.
newsitem.headline: KAUBAMAJA F SAYS SALES AS EXPECTED.

text.p: Tallinna Kaubamaja (Tallinn department store) said on Thursday that the sales figures at its recently opened Helsinki store are on target.
"The sales figures to date are in keeping with our plans," the store's project leader, Vello Tamm, told Reuters.
He declined to give any specific figures.
Kaubamaja estimates net sales of 20 million markka this year and has budgeted for a break-even result.
Tamm added Kaubamaja was satisfied with the result although the weather has not favoured the sales of seasonal clothing.
Tallinna Kaubamaja opened its Finnish subsidiary at the beginning of April. It has two subsidiaries in Estonia and plans to open a third later this year.
The company is traded on the free market of the Tallinn bourse.
